verdict.rationale: Canny documents a dedicated page for embedding a widget on a website (canny-docs-17) and a JavaScript SDK install (canny-docs-2), with the developer llms.txt also referencing widget setup, so web embedding is clearly supported. The pack has only page titles and summaries, so nothing confirms the specific single-script-tag, no-build-step part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence that the install is a single script tag, evidence that no build step or bundler is required, snippet-level install detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
